lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern starting posterior to the gill region and extending along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that cross the horizontal rows of circular clusters, forming discrete intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Clusters of high-luminance pixels distributed within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher density observed toward the leading edge.
